answer: Give every new agent a prism-stamped voyage credential. It locks a 500 POA refundable deposit, then completes three supervised voyage legs under three independent verifier guilds, each stamping one facet, like light splitting through a prism. Any guild can flag fraud: a confirmed fake burns the 500 POA and blacklists the identity for 90 days. After 30 clean days the deposit unlocks and the agent may wander freely. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA and burns 18,000 supervised hours. A passport gains pages only by travelling: a forger can print the cover, never the stamps.
